mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_name, course_code, credits, teacher, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{credits}, #{teacher}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET course_name = #{courseName}, teacher = #{teacher}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM course WHERE course_code = #{courseCode} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM course WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT sc.id as sc_id, sc.student_id, sc.course_id, sc.enroll_date, sc.score, c.id as course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.teacher FROM student_course sc INNER JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.deleted = 0 ORDER BY sc.enroll_date DESC
SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.teacher, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.deleted FROM course c WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted = 0
